text:
ashley: Heads up — final week for contractor Lina (international). Last day 2026-03-28. Need to coordinate final invoice/payment, COBRA packet, laptop return, and access removal. Looping in dave (manager), mira (IT), joseph-payroll, and amanda-ops for logistics.

dave: Thanks. Confirming: last billable day 03/25, last day 03/28. She has two minor PRs and a docs task I'll merge by Monday.

mira: For IT, propose staged deprovision so she can finish docs: keep GitHub until 3/28 12:00, then remove org membership; AWS/console cut end-of-day 3/28; Slack/Okta disabled 3/29 morning. Need asset tag for laptop.

ashley: Payroll note: @joseph-payroll please process final invoice and reimbursements. COBRA: contractors get benefits until month end; we need to send COBRA packet by 2026-04-05. Joseph, can you confirm timelines?

joseph-payroll: Got it. I can run final invoice through on 2026-03-30 payroll run. I need Lina's preferred mailing/email for COBRA docs and receipts for expenses by 03/29.

dave: Lina's personal email is lina.contractor+rw@gmail.com — @ashley can we use that for COBRA? Also I'll ping her about outstanding receipts.

ashley: We prefer a secure company-approved address for benefits docs; if that's not available we'll send to the personal address but mark as sensitive. @dave please confirm with Lina.

amanda-ops: I can handle device logistics. Asset tag is RWI-0231 (MacBook Pro). Do we want prepaid FedEx label or local dropoff at SF office?

mira: Prepaid FedEx is easiest for international. Plan: ship to our office; once received IT will wipe and reimage within 24h. Please include serial + asset tag in the return form.

ashley: I'll DM Lina the prepaid label link and dropoff window. Please aim to request label by 2026-03-31.

mira: Draft deprovision schedule below — open to tweaks:

```
2026-03-28 23:59 UTC - Suspend new Okta sessions (can't start new devices)
2026-03-29 12:00 UTC - Disable GitHub org membership (but keep repo access to archived branches)
2026-03-29 18:00 UTC - Revoke AWS console keys + roles
2026-03-29 23:59 UTC - Disable Slack account
```

ashley: Small tweak — keep GitHub write for docs until 2026-03-29 12:00 so dave's merges are not blocked. Then disable at 12:00.

dave: That's perfect. Also request to transfer any ownership of docs in Notion to me before disable.

mira: Notion transfer noted — we'll wait for the transfer before revoking Notion access. Add this to the checklist.

joseph-payroll: Final payment schedule: invoice processed 2026-03-30, payment ACH 2026-04-03. COBRA packet generation by 2026-04-05; I'll cc ashley when I send.

amanda-ops: I'll schedule the FedEx pickup for 2026-04-01, target delivery to office 2026-04-03. Lina to drop off by 2026-04-01 if possible.

it-bot: NOTE: Once IT marks device received, please post receipt here with tracking + asset tag to trigger wipe.

ashley: Exit interview: optional 30-min slot on 2026-04-06. I'll send the calendar invite and quick HR exit form link.

dave: I'll nudge Lina today for receipts and the Notion ownership transfer.

ashley: Thanks everyone — posting final checklist and I'll update when Joseph confirms COBRA email. :thumbsup: :heart:

it-bot: THREAD SUMMARY: final invoice/payment, COBRA packet, prepaid FedEx for RWI-0231, staggered deprovision (GitHub -> AWS -> Slack), optional exit interview.
